module roman.numerals
  purpose: Convert between bounded integers and Roman numerals.

public type RomanError is one of
  purpose: Why Roman numeral conversion failed.
  NumberOutOfRange(value: Integer)
  InvalidRomanNumeral(value: Text)
end

public function to_roman(value: Integer)
  returns Text
  or fails with RomanError
  purpose: Convert an integer from 1 to 3999 into a Roman numeral.
  example: to_roman(value: 1994) is "MCMXCIV"

  if value is less than 1 or value is greater than 3999 then
    fail with NumberOutOfRange(value: value)
  end

  let thousands be "M".repeat(value.quotient(1000))
  let hundreds_value be value remainder 1000
  let hundreds be roman_digit(digit: hundreds_value.quotient(100), one: "C", five: "D", ten: "M")
  let tens_value be hundreds_value remainder 100
  let tens be roman_digit(digit: tens_value.quotient(10), one: "X", five: "L", ten: "C")
  let ones be roman_digit(digit: tens_value remainder 10, one: "I", five: "V", ten: "X")

  return "{thousands}{hundreds}{tens}{ones}"
end

public function from_roman(numeral: Text)
  returns Integer
  or fails with RomanError
  purpose: Convert a Roman numeral into its integer value.
  example: from_roman(numeral: "MCMXCIV") is 1994

  if numeral.is_empty() then
    fail with InvalidRomanNumeral(value: numeral)
  end

  let mutable rest be numeral
  let mutable total be 0

  repeat until rest.is_empty()
    if rest.starts_with("CM") then
      set total to total + 900
      set rest to rest.drop(2)
    otherwise if rest.starts_with("CD") then
      set total to total + 400
      set rest to rest.drop(2)
    otherwise if rest.starts_with("XC") then
      set total to total + 90
      set rest to rest.drop(2)
    otherwise if rest.starts_with("XL") then
      set total to total + 40
      set rest to rest.drop(2)
    otherwise if rest.starts_with("IX") then
      set total to total + 9
      set rest to rest.drop(2)
    otherwise if rest.starts_with("IV") then
      set total to total + 4
      set rest to rest.drop(2)
    otherwise if rest.starts_with("M") then
      set total to total + 1000
      set rest to rest.drop(1)
    otherwise if rest.starts_with("D") then
      set total to total + 500
      set rest to rest.drop(1)
    otherwise if rest.starts_with("C") then
      set total to total + 100
      set rest to rest.drop(1)
    otherwise if rest.starts_with("L") then
      set total to total + 50
      set rest to rest.drop(1)
    otherwise if rest.starts_with("X") then
      set total to total + 10
      set rest to rest.drop(1)
    otherwise if rest.starts_with("V") then
      set total to total + 5
      set rest to rest.drop(1)
    otherwise if rest.starts_with("I") then
      set total to total + 1
      set rest to rest.drop(1)
    otherwise
      fail with InvalidRomanNumeral(value: numeral)
    end
  end

  let canonical be to_roman(value: total) otherwise fail with InvalidRomanNumeral(value: numeral)
  if canonical is not numeral then
    fail with InvalidRomanNumeral(value: numeral)
  end

  return total
end

function roman_digit(digit: Integer, one: Text, five: Text, ten: Text)
  returns Text
  purpose: Convert one decimal digit into Roman numeral symbols.
  example: roman_digit(digit: 4, one: "I", five: "V", ten: "X") is "IV"

  if digit is at most 3 then
    return one.repeat(digit)
  otherwise if digit is 4 then
    return "{one}{five}"
  otherwise if digit is at most 8 then
    return "{five}{one.repeat(digit - 5)}"
  otherwise
    return "{one}{ten}"
  end
end

module roman.numerals
  purpose: Convert between integers and Roman numerals.

public type RomanNumeralError is one of
  purpose: Why a Roman numeral conversion failed.
  NumberOutOfRange(value: Integer)
  InvalidRomanNumeral(value: Text)
end

public function to_roman(value: Integer)
  returns Text
  or fails with RomanNumeralError
  purpose: Convert an integer from 1 to 3999 to a Roman numeral.
  example: to_roman(1994) is "MCMXCIV"

  if value is less than 1 or value is greater than 3999 then
    fail with NumberOutOfRange(value: value)
  end

  let thousands be "M".repeat(value.quotient(1000))
  let hundreds be roman_digit(count: value.remainder(1000).quotient(100), one: "C", five: "D", ten: "M")
  let tens be roman_digit(count: value.remainder(100).quotient(10), one: "X", five: "L", ten: "C")
  let ones be roman_digit(count: value.remainder(10), one: "I", five: "V", ten: "X")

  return thousands + hundreds + tens + ones
end

public function from_roman(value: Text)
  returns Integer
  or fails with RomanNumeralError
  purpose: Convert a canonical Roman numeral from 1 to 3999 to an integer.
  example: from_roman("MCMXCIV") is 1994

  if value.is_empty() then
    fail with InvalidRomanNumeral(value: value)
  end

  let parsed be parse_roman(value) otherwise fail
  let canonical be to_roman(parsed) otherwise fail

  if canonical is not value then
    fail with InvalidRomanNumeral(value: value)
  end

  return parsed
end

function roman_digit(count: Integer, one: Text, five: Text, ten: Text)
  returns Text

  if count is at most 3 then
    return one.repeat(count)
  otherwise if count is 4 then
    return one + five
  otherwise if count is 5 then
    return five
  otherwise if count is at most 8 then
    return five + one.repeat(count - 5)
  otherwise
    return one + ten
  end
end

function parse_roman(value: Text)
  returns Integer
  or fails with RomanNumeralError

  let mutable index be 0
  let mutable total be 0
  let characters be value.characters()

  repeat until index is at least characters.length()
    let current be characters.at(index) otherwise fail with InvalidRomanNumeral(value: value)
    let current_value be roman_value(current) otherwise fail with InvalidRomanNumeral(value: value)
    let next be characters.at(index + 1) otherwise nothing

    match next
      when some(next_character) then
        let next_value be roman_value(next_character) otherwise fail with InvalidRomanNumeral(value: value)

        if current_value is less than next_value then
          set total to total + next_value - current_value
          set index to index + 2
        otherwise
          set total to total + current_value
          set index to index + 1
        end
      when nothing then
        set total to total + current_value
        set index to index + 1
    end
  end

  if total is less than 1 or total is greater than 3999 then
    fail with InvalidRomanNumeral(value: value)
  end

  return total
end

function roman_value(character: Text)
  returns Integer
  or fails with RomanNumeralError

  if character is "I" then
    return 1
  otherwise if character is "V" then
    return 5
  otherwise if character is "X" then
    return 10
  otherwise if character is "L" then
    return 50
  otherwise if character is "C" then
    return 100
  otherwise if character is "D" then
    return 500
  otherwise if character is "M" then
    return 1000
  otherwise
    fail with InvalidRomanNumeral(value: character)
  end
end

  if value is less than 1 or value is greater than 3999 then
    fail with OutOfRange(value: value)
  end

  let mutable remaining be value
  let mutable numeral be ""

  repeat until remaining is less than 1000
    set numeral to "{numeral}M"
    set remaining to remaining - 1000
  end

  if remaining is at least 900 then
    set numeral to "{numeral}CM"
    set remaining to remaining - 900
  end

  if remaining is at least 500 then
    set numeral to "{numeral}D"
    set remaining to remaining - 500
  end

  if remaining is at least 400 then
    set numeral to "{numeral}CD"
    set remaining to remaining - 400
  end

  repeat until remaining is less than 100
    set numeral to "{numeral}C"
    set remaining to remaining - 100
  end

  if remaining is at least 90 then
    set numeral to "{numeral}XC"
    set remaining to remaining - 90
  end

  if remaining is at least 50 then
    set numeral to "{numeral}L"
    set remaining to remaining - 50
  end

  if remaining is at least 40 then
    set numeral to "{numeral}XL"
    set remaining to remaining - 40
  end

  repeat until remaining is less than 10
    set numeral to "{numeral}X"
    set remaining to remaining - 10
  end

  if remaining is 9 then
    set numeral to "{numeral}IX"
    set remaining to remaining - 9
  end

  if remaining is at least 5 then
    set numeral to "{numeral}V"
    set remaining to remaining - 5
  end

  if remaining is 4 then
    set numeral to "{numeral}IV"
    set remaining to remaining - 4
  end

  repeat until remaining is less than 1
    set numeral to "{numeral}I"
    set remaining to remaining - 1
  end

  return numeral
end

public function roman_to_integer(numeral: Text)
  returns Integer
  or fails with RomanError
  purpose: Convert a Roman numeral to an integer from 1 to 3999.
  example: roman_to_integer(numeral: "MCMXCIV") is 1994

  if numeral.is_empty then
    fail with InvalidRoman(numeral: numeral)
  end

  let mutable total be 0
  let mutable previous be 0

  for each symbol in numeral.characters()
    let current be roman_symbol_value(symbol: symbol, numeral: numeral) otherwise fail

    if previous is less than current then
      set total to total + current - previous - previous
    otherwise
      set total to total + current
    end

    set previous to current
  end

  let canonical be integer_to_roman(value: total) otherwise fail

  if canonical is not numeral then
    fail with InvalidRoman(numeral: numeral)
  end

  return total
end

function roman_symbol_value(symbol: Text, numeral: Text)
  returns Integer
  or fails with RomanError
  purpose: Convert one Roman numeral symbol to its integer value.
  example: roman_symbol_value(symbol: "X", numeral: "X") is 10

  match symbol
    when "I" then return 1
    when "V" then return 5
    when "X" then return 10
    when "L" then return 50
    when "C" then return 100
    when "D" then return 500
    when "M" then return 1000
    otherwise fail with InvalidRoman(numeral: numeral)
  end
end

module roman.numerals
  purpose: Convert between integers and Roman numerals.

public type RomanError is one of
  purpose: Why a Roman numeral conversion failed.
  OutOfRange(value: Integer)
  EmptyInput
  InvalidCharacter(character: Text)
  InvalidOrder(text: Text)
  NonCanonical(text: Text)
end

type RomanEntry
  purpose: A Roman numeral token and its integer value.
  has glyph: Text
  has value: Integer
end

public function to_roman(value: Integer)
  returns Text
  or fails with RomanError
  purpose: Convert an integer from 1 to 3999 to a Roman numeral.
  example: to_roman(1994) is "MCMXCIV"

  if value is less than 1 or value is greater than 3999 then
    fail with OutOfRange(value: value)
  end

  let entries be roman_entries()
  let mutable remaining be value
  let mutable numeral be ""

  for each entry in entries
    repeat until remaining is less than entry.value
      set numeral to "{numeral}{entry.glyph}"
      set remaining to remaining - entry.value
    end
  end

  return numeral
end

public function from_roman(numeral: Text)
  returns Integer
  or fails with RomanError
  purpose: Convert a Roman numeral to an integer from 1 to 3999.
  example: from_roman("MCMXCIV") is 1994

  if numeral.is_empty then
    fail with EmptyInput
  end

  let entries be roman_entries()
  let mutable remaining be numeral
  let mutable total be 0

  repeat until remaining.is_empty
    let before be remaining
    for each entry in entries
      if remaining.starts_with(entry.glyph) then
        set total to total + entry.value
        set remaining to remaining.drop(entry.glyph.length)
        break
      end
    end

    if remaining is before then
      let character be remaining.take(1)
      if is_roman_character(character) then
        fail with InvalidOrder(text: numeral)
      end
      fail with InvalidCharacter(character: character)
    end
  end

  if total is less than 1 or total is greater than 3999 then
    fail with OutOfRange(value: total)
  end

  let canonical be to_roman(total) otherwise fail
  if canonical is not numeral then
    fail with NonCanonical(text: numeral)
  end

  return total
end

function roman_entries()
  returns List of RomanEntry
  purpose: List Roman numeral tokens in descending value order.
  example: roman_entries().first.glyph is "M"

  return [
    RomanEntry(glyph: "M", value: 1000),
    RomanEntry(glyph: "CM", value: 900),
    RomanEntry(glyph: "D", value: 500),
    RomanEntry(glyph: "CD", value: 400),
    RomanEntry(glyph: "C", value: 100),
    RomanEntry(glyph: "XC", value: 90),
    RomanEntry(glyph: "L", value: 50),
    RomanEntry(glyph: "XL", value: 40),
    RomanEntry(glyph: "X", value: 10),
    RomanEntry(glyph: "IX", value: 9),
    RomanEntry(glyph: "V", value: 5),
    RomanEntry(glyph: "IV", value: 4),
    RomanEntry(glyph: "I", value: 1)
  ]
end

function is_roman_character(character: Text)
  returns Boolean
  purpose: Report whether a one-character text is a Roman numeral letter.
  example: is_roman_character("X") is true

  return character is "I"
    or character is "V"
    or character is "X"
    or character is "L"
    or character is "C"
    or character is "D"
    or character is "M"
end
